verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a WHOIS privacy feature exists (enable-whois-privacy endpoint, whois-privacy page) but nothing in the evidence pack states it is free, on by default, or has no upsell — pricing docs only mention TLD registration pricing tiers, not privacy fees. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that WHOIS privacy is included free at registration, that it is enabled by default (not opt-in), and absence of any paid privacy upsell tier.
